function.arguments: {"paragraphs":["Comparing four baseline models (dummy_prior, logistic_regression, random_forest, xgboost) across 840 training rows, logistic_regression was selected by validation average precision of 0.785, outperforming dummy_prior (0.461) and delivering a 1.7× lift over the prior baseline.","At the fixed 0.500 threshold logistic_regression flagged 75 of 180 validation customers, achieving precision of 0.707 and recall of 0.639; it missed 30 churners and produced 22 false alerts, giving an F1 of 0.671.","Before launching any outreach, verify feature availability and cost structure; no measured intervention effect or financial return exists, and the reserved test partition must be used for final performance confirmation."]}
